§6Latex§f

§aNature's rubber. Cheap, renewable, and you probably have dandelions.§f

Latex balls come from §bdandelions§f (2x2 crafting grid) or by pressing §bjungle wood§f with a flat stamp in the burner or electric press. Smelt the ball into a §blatex bar§f to use in recipes.

Early-game uses: §bconveyor belts§f (cheaper than rubber), the §bore acidizer§f (latex bar + sour gas → rubber), and various machine components like insulated wire and seals.

Once you automate a tree farm with a press, latex becomes infinite. It's not as good as processed rubber, but it gets you through the early game without much effort.

§ePS:§f Rubber from the ore acidizer is the better long-term option, but latex gets you started.
